AN HONEST DELIVERY MAP.

All proposed ideas are accounted for below. “Implemented” means a local feature is implemented in source, not that a complete production-commerce integration is verified. Browser visual QA remains unavailable because the managed preview failed to mount its process filesystem. No live backend services, actual customer content or physical production are fabricated.

29 implemented · 28 partial · 43 require assets, operational work or service integrations.

Publication remains owner-private. Public QR printing, commerce launch and customer outreach have not occurred. Generated imagery and garment illustrations are concept assets. This build does not change Magento orders, products or credentials.
